# Repository Instructions

- Keep `changelog.md` up to date in the same change whenever code, configuration, documentation, compatibility, or developer workflow behavior changes.
- Add concise user-facing entries under `## [Unreleased] - YYYY-MM-DD`; preserve existing entries and headings.
- Do not consider a behavior-affecting change complete until its changelog entry has been reviewed for accuracy.
- Use the `changelog-maintenance` skill for the detailed changelog workflow.
